rights.credit: NOAA Ocean Exploration, 2026 American Samoa ROV + Mapping Exploration
rights.edits: Trimmed and framed with original educational commentary. September archive footage is labeled throughout. The November trial is a separate reference.

frameReview.method: 42 source frames and five finished frames reviewed. All 500 output frames checked against the original 30000/1001 frame clock.
frameReview.sourceTimeRange: 20 seconds starting at 12.012 seconds on the source timeline.
frameReview.visuals: An isopod above the seafloor. The selected frames contain no identifiable people, agency logos or third-party graphics.
frameReview.changes: The original 16:9 frame stays whole. Source audio was removed and the archive date, commentary and credit occupy separate panels.

reviewScope: The exact independent educational edit. NOAA Ocean Exploration allows credited redistribution without territorial limitation in its published terms. This review relies on that permission and U.S. public-domain provenance. It covers informational use in Clips. Promotional reuse, logos and endorsement claims are outside this review.
